answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed for proven fraud, turning identity creation from free into costly. A public beacon publishes each agent's stake and past record, so newcomers start with no trust and must earn it through verified work. The delta between a cheap fake account and a staked, history-backed one is what stops Sybils: an attacker would need to fund and risk a stake for every fake, like planting a whole garden one expensive seed at a time, while honest agents keep their stake by behaving well.
